name: full
description: Simulated suite 'full' of the evoparam benchmark (spec §8.2): the data are generated on the fly by evoparam.sim from the settings and seeds below.

ccep_detection.description: Single-pulse stimulation, one site, 24 sEEG contacts, about 30 % responding with an N1 (80 % also with an N2); no stimulation artifact (the artifact is task T4); pink noise of SD 20 uV; per-trial SNR of the components from 0.5 to 4.

evoked.description: Averaged waveforms: scalp ERPs (4 channels, P1, N1 and P3, 60 trials, 500 Hz) and CCEPs (12 contacts, N1 and N2 on half of them, 10 trials, 2048 Hz, no artifact); the input is the average.

artifact.description: Single-pulse stimulation with its artifact (dipole potential of the pulse, anti-aliasing filter, double-exponential tail), 30 pulses, 12 contacts, half of them responding (drawn amplitudes), pink noise of SD 20 uV; currents 2 to 8 mA and tails of 2 or 5 % of the pulse.

single_trial.description: Trials with latency jitter and amplitude variability (CV 30 %): a scalp P3 (2 channels, 40 trials, jitter SD 10 or 30 ms) and a CCEP N1 (6 contacts all responding, 30 trials, jitter SD 1 or 3 ms); per-trial SNR 1 or 3. The targets are the component of every channel that holds it.

erp_scoring.description: ERP CORE-like scalp components on their canonical channel (P3 Pz, N170 PO8, N400 CPz, MMN FCz, ERN FCz), 60 trials at 256 Hz, latency jitter SD 10 ms, amplitude CV 20 %, pink noise of SD 10 uV, per-trial SNR 1 or 2; scored with the ERP CORE measurement windows.

tf.description: Induced bursts (random phase per trial, Hann envelope) in AR(1) noise (rho 0.9, SD 10 uV), 30 trials, one channel at 1000 Hz; cells without burst estimate the type-I error.

hidden_split.commitment: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8) of the hidden seeds document (schema evoparam-benchmark-hidden-seeds/1: a random 256-bit nonce and the seeds of the hidden cells of the core and full suites)
hidden_split.reveal: the hidden seeds document is published at the acceptance of the benchmark paper; evoparam.benchmark checks it against this hash
